_doc: game_health_check.py (HEALTH_CHECK_MONITOR_MEMORY_TPS_OVER_TIME, owner C24 in design/RimMandrake/mod_audit/OWNER_RULINGS.md). A full-list session whose summary crosses any limit below is a BREACH; ops_watch's tps family reads the newest recorded session's breaches and rings OPS_GAME_HEALTH_DEBUG. Owner C24: 'Target our desktop ... numeric targets are set against his desktop and revised from measurement'. Each limit says what it was set from. Agents may tighten or add a limit (delegation_policy 2.1); loosening one is the owner's.
_full_list_min_mods_doc: a session is 'full-list' when its session row reports at least this many mods (the owner's list measured 317-321 mods 2026-10-27..11-02; quicktest tiers 11-23)
_end_clean_doc: end.clean is recorded but is not a limit: a kill by ./game down leaves no shutdown row either, so the record cannot tell it from a crash
_ended_after_min_doc: a session with no shutdown row is recorded as ended-without-shutdown (a crash or kill) once a newer session exists on disk, or its newest row is older than this (12 h: a hang or a machine sleep can recover)
_growth_min_span_min_doc: a memory growth rate needs at least this much in-game time after the first game load, else it is UNMEASURED
_ratio_window_min_doc: TPS decay compares the median run-window ratio of the first and the last this-many minutes after the first game load, at the session's dominant speed multiplier

limits.why: the game did not reach the main menu: not loadable
a cold load measured ~15-25 min on the full list (CLAUDE.md, 2026-09-07); over 30 min is a regression
managed (Mono GC) heap; the full-list sessions 2026-10-26..28 peaked 3.9-5.1 GB (game_health_check.py record --dry-run, 2026-11-02), so 6 GB is about 1.2x the worst seen
a heap that grows over 1 GB per hour of play reaches the 6 GB line within a long sitting
process private bytes; the desktop has 64 GB, and over 24 GB starves the seats and the build host
private bytes growing over 2 GB per hour is a leak in managed, native or GPU-staging memory
Unity native allocators (Profiler.GetTotalReservedMemoryLong); set wide until a full-list session measures it
TPS ratio in the last window below 70% of the first window at the same speed: the game slows as it runs
a single unexplained stall over 30 s outside a long event (loading/map generation stalls are reported as tps.longevent_max_s, not judged)
error+exception messages in one session; 'how many errors are we currently producing in the log?' (C24)
Verse.Log's 1000-entry queue evicted entries between two once-a-minute scans: the error count is only a floor, and over 1000 new messages in a minute is itself log spam
Verse.Log hit its 10,000-message cap: emission suppressed, error activity unknown
